sectionIntro: Every pizza is an authentic 12-inch Neapolitan pie crafted from 72-hour slow-fermented dough, stretched gently by hand to preserve the airy cornicione, and flash-baked in our 900°F wood-fired hearth.
orderingNote: Dine-In & Walk-In Only: To preserve the airy crust texture directly from the 900° wood hearth, we do not provide third-party delivery or online ordering. Walk-ins are always welcomed on a first-come, first-served basis. Takeaway is available in person at the counter.

categories.title: Neapolitan Pizzas (Pizze Napoletane)
categories.subtitle: Strict Neapolitan discipline: hand-crushed San Marzano D.O.P. tomatoes, fresh basil, 72-hour cold-fermented dough, flash-baked in 90 seconds at 900°F

items.name: Margherita Verace D.O.P.
items.description: Crushed San Marzano D.O.P. tomatoes, fresh fior di latte mozzarella d’Agerola, aged pecorino romano, organic Genovese basil, cold-pressed extra virgin olive oil.

items.name: Marinara Antica (Est. 1734)
items.description: Slow-simmered San Marzano tomatoes, thinly shaved fresh garlic, wild Sicilian mountain oregano, sea salt, cold-pressed olive oil. No cheese.

items.name: Bufalina D.O.P.
items.description: San Marzano D.O.P. tomatoes, fresh creamy Mozzarella di Bufala Campana flown in weekly, torn fresh sweet basil, coarse Sicilian sea salt, EVOO.

items.name: La Cosacca (Historic 1844)
items.description: Crushed sweet San Marzano tomatoes, abundant grated 18-month Pecorino Romano D.O.P., fresh sweet basil, cracked black pepper, extra virgin olive oil. The historic minimalist street pizza of Naples.

items.name: Diavola Napoletana
items.description: San Marzano D.O.P. sauce, smoked provola affumicata cheese, artisan spicy salame napoletano, crushed fermented Calabrian hot chili paste, wild mountain oregano.

items.name: Capricciosa Napoletana
items.description: San Marzano tomato base, fior di latte, artisanal prosciutto cotto (rosemary ham), wood-roasted cremini mushrooms, tender artichoke hearts, Gaeta black olives.

categories.title: Small Plates & Fresh Greens
categories.subtitle: Artisan accompaniments prepared with wood-fired hearth techniques

items.name: Castelfranco & Shaved Parmigiano
items.description: Speckled Castelfranco radicchio, shaved 24-month Parmigiano-Reggiano, toasted pine nuts, white Modena balsamic vinaigrette.

items.name: Warm 72-Hour Focaccia & Cultured Butter
items.italianName: Focaccia della Casa al Burro Nocciola
items.description: Hearth-baked wedge of our signature 72-hour dough topped with rosemary, sea salt, served with house-whipped cultured honey-herb butter.

items.name: Wood-Warmed Castelvetrano Olives
items.description: Vibrant green Sicilian olives gently warmed in the oven mouth with preserved lemon peel, cracked coriander, and wild fennel.

categories.title: Non-Alcoholic Refreshments
categories.subtitle: Traditional Italian sodas, sparkling mountain mineral water, and house herbal infusions

items.name: Italian Sparkling Mineral Water (750ml)
items.description: Bottled at the source in San Pellegrino Terme, crisp fine effervescence.

items.name: Artisanal Chinotto & Aranciata Amara
items.description: Bitter citrus Sicilian herbal soda brewed with Ligurian myrtle-leaf orange extracts.

items.name: Fresh Sicilian Meyer Lemon & Rosemary Soda
items.description: Hand-squeezed Meyer lemons, crushed garden rosemary syrup, and sparkling spring water.

items.name: Cold-Brewed Hibiscus & Blood Orange Tea
items.description: Unsweetened slow cold-steeped wild hibiscus flowers, dried blood orange peel, and fresh mint sprig.
